intro: Canggu is a beach town in Bali with sunsets, green rice fields, and beaches perfect for surfing. At Bali Yoga School, we’ve made simple yoga courses that combine traditional yoga wisdom with Canggu’s chill, friendly vibe. No matter if you’re new to teaching or already have experience, our programs meet you where you are.

Bali Yoga School offers yoga teacher training in Canggu, Bali. We teach the traditional way, like meditation, breathing practices, and yoga philosophy. We’re part of the Himalayan Yoga Association, a yoga school from Rishikesh, India. They started Bali Yoga School to share their knowledge in Bali’s peaceful, natural setting.
Yogi Himanshu personally designed all our courses in Canggu Bali.
